<script type="text/javascript" >
window.onscroll = function () {

$('[id$=scrollPos]').val(document.documentElement.scrollTop);

};
function keepscrollpos() {

document.documentElement.scrollTop = $('[id$=scrollPos]').val();

<script type="text/javascript" >

function AddToMyDocs(btn) {

var strDocSpec;
var td;
var tr;
var idCell;
var mydata;
var $hL;
var strMsg;
var childarray;


try {


td = btn.parentElement;
tr = td.parentElement;
idCell = tr.children[3];
strDocSpec = idCell.innerText;

mydata = { 'docspec': strDocSpec };

jQuery.ajax({
type: 'GET',
url: 'SolutionAddMyDocHandler.ashx',
data: mydata,
success: function (data) {

var strMsg;
var $hLink;


$hLink = $('[id$=hlPrintCart]');


strMsg = data.toString();
$hLink.text(strMsg);

if (strMsg.length < 1) {
$hLink.hide();
}
else {
$hLink.show();
btn.value = 'My Doc*';
}



},
error: function () {

var $hLink;


$hLink = $("[id$=hlPrintCart]");

$hLink.attr('text', '');
$hLink.attr('visibility', false);

}
});

}


return false;
}



function SetMyDocsFlags(strMyDocsArray, strViewedArray) {
var tabResults;
var strRecIDSpec;
var allrows;
var innerH;
var intPos;
var $myDocsLink;
var intCount;
var strMyDocsText;

if (!strMyDocsArray) {
strMyDocsArray = [];
}
if (!strViewedArray) {
strViewedArray = [];
}

tabResults = $('[id$=grdResults]');


allrows = tabResults.find('tr');

// set the MyDocs flag
allrows.each(function (i, el) {


// the first row is the column header
if (i >= 1) {
strRecIDSpec = el.cells[3].innerText.trim();

intPos = strMyDocsArray.indexOf(strRecIDSpec);

innerH = el.cells[1].innerHTML;

if (intPos >= 0) {

innerH = innerH.replace('"My Doc\"', '"My Doc*\"');

} else {

innerH = innerH.replace('"My Doc*\"', '"My Doc\"');
}

el.cells[1].innerHTML = innerH;



intPos = strViewedArray.indexOf(strRecIDSpec);


if (intPos >= 0) {
// this is a viewed row, highlight it
// unlike mydocs, an image cant be un-viewed, so we never need to clear any highlights
try {

el.style.backgroundColor = 'yellow';

} catch (e) {

}


}

}

});


try {
$myDocsLink = $('[id$=hlPrintCart]');

intCount = strMyDocsArray.length;

if (intCount < 1) {
$myDocsLink.text('');
} else {
if (intCount == 1) {
strMyDocsText = 'My Documents contains 1 item';
} else {
strMyDocsText = 'My Documents contains ' + intCount.toString() + ' items';
}
$myDocsLink.text(strMyDocsText);
}


} catch (e) {

}


}


$(document).ready(function () {

var strMyDocsArray;
var strViewedArray;


jQuery.ajax({
type: 'GET',
url: 'SolutionGetMyDocsHandler.ashx',
success: function (data) {


strMyDocsArray = data.mydocsarray;
if (!strMyDocsArray) {
strMyDocsArray = [];
}

strViewedArray = data.viewedarray;
if (!strViewedArray) {
strViewedArray = [];
}

SetMyDocsFlags(strMyDocsArray, strViewedArray);

}
});


});

<script type="text/javascript">



function TimedAccessIsExpired() {
var exp;

try {

exp = $('[id$=hidPageAccessExpire]').val();

if (isNumber(exp)) {
exp = parseInt(exp);
if (exp == 0) {
return true;
}
}

}
catch (e) { }

return false;
}

function RunTimedAccessCheck() {


try {
jQuery.ajax({
type: 'GET',
url: 'SolutionTimedAccessHandler.ashx',
success: function (data) {

if (data.expired) {

RunTimedAccessDialog();

}

}

});
}

catch (e) {
}

}

function RunTimedAccessDialog() {

var convfee;
var rate;
var rateper;
var allowsave;
var prev4;
var chgdesc;

allowsave = 0;
chgdesc = 'Access Charge';

convfee = $('[id$=hidTimedAccessConvFee]').val();
rate = $('[id$=hidTimedAccessRate]').val();
rateper = $('[id$=hidTimedAccessRatePer]').val();
prev4 = $('[id$=hidPrev4]').val();
allowsave = $('[id$=hidAllowCCSave]').val();

if (isNumber(convfee)) {
convfee = parseFloat(convfee);
}
else {
convfee = 0.0;
}

if (isNumber(rate)) {
rate = parseFloat(rate);
}
else {
rate = 0.0;
}

if (isNumber(rateper)) {
rateper = parseInt(rateper);
if (rateper < 1) {
rateper = 1;
}
}
else {
rateper = 1;
}

if (!prev4) {
prev4 = '';
}

if (isNumber(allowsave)) {
allowsave = parseInt(allowsave);
}
else {
allowsave = 0;
}

ShowPayTimedAccessDialog(chgdesc, convfee, rate, rateper, allowsave, prev4);

}


// trap the submit event for the main form
// we check this for timed access
$('[id$=aspnetForm]').submit(function () {

var t;
var intMin;
var diff;
var now;

try{
exp = $('[id$=hidPageAccessExpire]').val();
if (isNumber(exp)) {

exp = parseInt(exp);
if (exp < 0) {
// no expiration
return true;
}

if (exp == 0) {
// already expired
// show the dialog and dont submit now.
// the dialog will either submit or logout
RunTimedAccessDialog();
return false;
}

now = new Date();

diff = now.getTime() - __pageloadtime.getTime();
diff = diff / (1000 * 60);
diff = diff.toFixed();

// give them a minute leeway
if (diff - 1 > exp ) {

// show the dialog and dont submit now.
// the dialog will either submit or logout
RunTimedAccessDialog();
return false;
}
else {
return true;
}



}

function RunTimedAccessCheck2() {

var expmin;

try {
expmin = $('[id$=hidPageAccessExpire]').val();
if (isNumber(expmin)) {

// get the expire minutes
intExMin = parseInt(expmin);

if (intExMin < 0) {
// we are not using timed access
return
}

// if the user hit the back button
if (!!window.performance && window.performance.navigation.type == 2) {
// if we are running timed access and we got this page from the cache, then we always check
if (intExMin > 0) {
RunTimedAccessCheck();
}


} else {
// we got this from the server
if (intExMin == 0) {
// we are expired
RunTimedAccessDialog();
}

}

}

}
catch (e) {

}

}
